copy.title: Genderpoly
copy.subtitle: One career. Another turn.
copy.introduction: [PLACEHOLDER] Your first day in the creative industries begins here. Choose your badge and a name, then follow the career board. Each decision stays with this career.
copy.promotionText: [PLACEHOLDER] You now sit on the other side of the table. Your next decisions concern the people and rules that will shape another career.

statDescriptions.Creativity: Developing original ideas and creative contributions.
statDescriptions.Communication: Communicating ideas and working with others.
statDescriptions.Energy: The energy available to sustain work and recover.
statDescriptions.Network: Access to professional contacts and opportunities.
statDescriptions.Reputation: How others in the workplace regard your work.
statDescriptions.Availability: The time and flexibility you can offer the workplace.
statDescriptions.Money: Financial resources available to support your career.

copy.gatekeeperReturning: [PLACEHOLDER] {name}, who held the director’s chair in the previous career, is now reviewing your application.
copy.gatekeeperFormal: [PLACEHOLDER] The recruitment policy uses written criteria for this appointment.
copy.gatekeeperUnchanged: [PLACEHOLDER] The office continues to use its established recruitment process.

endings.name: A Personal Choice
endings.front: You decided to step back. Everyone agreed it was the right choice for your family.
endings.back: Leaving is framed as an individual choice, while the pressures behind it stay invisible.
endings.triggerNote: Ch3 Boss 时 Availability 不足，选择离开行业
endings.nextRoundNote: 下一局的 Gatekeeper 是另一位默认 CD

endings.name: Nothing Needed to Change
endings.front: You made it to the top. The rules never changed. For you, they never needed to.
endings.back: Inequality can be reproduced through routine, reasonable decisions, without any open discrimination.
endings.triggerNote: 成为 CD 并通过 The System，没有推行任何政策
endings.nextRoundNote: 下一局的 Gatekeeper 就是你，规则不变

endings.name: Before the Door Opened
endings.front: [PLACEHOLDER] The role goes to someone else. You are encouraged to keep building your portfolio.
endings.back: [PLACEHOLDER THEORY NOTE] The team will connect this ending to gendered ideas of creative fit.
endings.nextRoundNote: Default director at the next Gatekeeper

endings.name: Outside the Circle
endings.front: [PLACEHOLDER] The promotion is decided after a conversation you were not part of.
endings.back: [PLACEHOLDER THEORY NOTE] The team will connect this ending to informal networks and access to opportunity.
endings.nextRoundNote: Default director at the next Gatekeeper

endings.name: No Energy Left
endings.front: [PLACEHOLDER] You leave the project before the next milestone. The work continues without you.
endings.back: [PLACEHOLDER THEORY NOTE] The team will connect this ending to the unequal costs of sustaining a creative career.
endings.nextRoundNote: Director and intern carry over only if already chosen

endings.name: A Written Rule
endings.front: [PLACEHOLDER] The next vacancy has written criteria. A new applicant is about to enter the room.
endings.back: [PLACEHOLDER THEORY NOTE] The team will discuss how formal procedures can change one mechanism of exclusion without resolving every inequality.
endings.triggerNote: Completed a career after selecting formal recruitment
endings.nextRoundNote: You become the next Gatekeeper; formal recruitment removes the hidden fit penalty
endings.artNote: A recruitment policy on the desk
